scope_lock: Selected after initial source and literature screening; locked before symbolic and numerical verification. No claim of external preregistration.
targets: Determine whether the existing C M residual-force law follows from the pinned C1 action.
Derive a measurable optical prediction from an existing nonzero C1 scalar-photon coupling.
Classify overlap with known scalar-photon models and translate an existing experiment's bound.
Retain all failed implications; do not choose coupling or mass from the desired outcome.

projection.fields: One real scalar sigma=varphi_W and the M-sector Maxwell field
projection.couplings: Only c_MW=g_MW nonzero; physical photon coupling g=4 c_MW
projection.scalar_mass: m>0, freely specified; no value predicted by C1

assumptions: Identify the C1 M-sector gauge field with calibrated laboratory electromagnetism.
Applied magnetic field and detector are characterized external apparatus; not derived from C1's source-free action.
Weak field around a self-consistent scalar background; positive gauge kinetic factor; m^2>=0.
Relativistic forward propagation: m/omega << 1 and |g B|/omega << 1; optical vacuum.
Photon-opaque wall sufficiently transparent to the hypothetical scalar; separate apparatus assumption.
Single scalar, no extra couplings, single pass, negligible depletion, no resonant enhancement.
No physical data, independent replication, or new-physics discovery is claimed.
checks: Symbolic Euler-Lagrange signs and the mapping g=4 c_MW.
Quadratic coupled-wave determinant and Hermiticity after field rephasing.
Matrix exponential versus closed conversion formula over a predeclared dimensionless grid.
Weak-mixing and zero-coupling limits; polarization selection; scaling checks.
Cross-check magnetic unit conversion and probability against independent amplitude integration.
Document background and systematic requirements and existing scalar-model degeneracy.

example.type: Illustrative calculation using published magnet/laser geometry, not a recreation of OSQAR's likelihood
